videos.why: Moved above rank's 6.6: a pick-one hook (China or Pakistan?) every viewer has an answer to, frame 0 is two flags around India, and the payoff (Bangladesh) breaks the guess.
strengths: Pick-one question in the first second, answer held back
Every neighbour shown in its flag, a length on each border
Surprising payoff that loops straight back to the hook
risks: Long spoken figures (km with decimals) slow the middle a little

videos.why: Strong for a formation story: the three big Hindi-belt states are named at frame 0 and the Uttaranchal-to-Uttarakhand payoff is a real surprise, but the hook's 'why' is less of a gut guess than #1's.
strengths: Names states most viewers live in
Cut lines draw on the map three times
Payoff: the 27th state had another name
risks: Dated history (November 2000) may feel textbook to some viewers
